name: Refracting Glass
description: A clear panel that bends whatever is behind it, strongest at the rim, with frosted glass as the fallback.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels, or `pill` for fully rounded ends.

props.name: bevel
props.description: Width of the curved rim in pixels. Inside it the glass is flat and nearly undistorted.

props.name: refraction
props.description: How far the rim bends the backdrop, in pixels at the very edge.

props.name: aberration
props.description: Colour fringing at the rim, from 0 (none) to 1.

props.name: frost
props.description: Blur of the backdrop in pixels. Where refraction is not supported, the panel falls back to frosted glass with at least 14px of blur.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour laid over the backdrop. Without it, a faint snow tint by day and a faint ink tint at night. Use a translucent colour.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content on the glass. It stays crisp; only the backdrop is bent.
